_provenance: captured-from: real `hermes-agent` 0.19.0 plugin loader and `invoke_hook` dispatcher; kwargs verbatim from the 0.19.0 invoke sites; not a live model turn. This file is byte-for-byte the envelope `plugins/hermes/__init__.py` built and teed while `hermes_cli.plugins.invoke_hook("pre_llm_call", ...)` drove it, with only this _provenance key added. `telemetry_schema_version` is injected by the dispatcher, not by the invoke site. Recapture: `pip install --only-binary :all: hermes-agent==0.19.0` into a scratch venv, copy `plugins/hermes/{plugin.yaml,__init__.py}` to $HERMES_HOME/plugins/popoto-memory/, write $HERMES_HOME/config.yaml with `plugins: {enabled: [popoto-memory]}`, export POPOTO_HOOK_CAPTURE=<dir>, then call PluginManager().discover_and_load(force=True) followed by invoke_hook("pre_llm_call", **kwargs) -- see tests/test_hermes_plugin_contract.py, which performs exactly this. No provider credentials are needed and none were used: a live model turn is out of scope for this repo's CI.
